doc_metadata.notes: Rated criteria response form instructing proponents on submission format, content requirements, and evaluation criteria for HR Advisory services. Specifies page limits, font requirements, and structured response sections covering corporate profile, key personnel, methodology, thought leadership, relationship management, value-added services, and relevant experience.
doc_metadata.title: APPENDIX D2 - RATED CRITERIA RESPONSE FORM – HR Advisory

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of proponent's organization description, purpose, structure, makeup, profile, history, employee count, products and services offered, range and depth of experience, core areas of expertise, and identification of requirements falling outside firm's scope.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup. Responses should include: Profile and history of the organisation; Number of employees; A list and description of the products and services you offer in support of the objectives and scope described in this service category, the range and depth of your experience with each, and identify which are your core areas of expertise or specialty; A list of any of our requirements that fall outside your firm's scope.

evaluation_criteria.title: Corporate Profile

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of proponent's team capabilities and capacity, including brief profiles of up to 4 key personnel in dedicated relationship or coordination roles (name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, credentials) and description of practitioner talent bench/roster (range of expertise, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards, typical resource assignment process).

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, lead consultant, research specialist.

evaluation_criteria.title: Methodology & Advisory Approach
